assumed: Depth bands are CIELAB L* cut points chosen by the reviewer (ASSUMED), not a published scale.
Undertone hue-angle cut points match services/shade.py (warm >= 62 degrees, cool <= 48 degrees); olive is ASSUMED as warm hue with low a* (a* < 9) and b* > 13.
